title: Joshua's Meeting with the Commander of the Lord's Army
description: Before the conquest of Jericho, Joshua meets a man with a drawn sword who reveals himself as the commander of the Lord's army. Joshua falls down and worships, and is told to take off his sandals because the place is holy.
